text.p: Bayern Munich's young midfielder Dietmar Hamann suffered a stroke on Thursday evening and will remain in hospital for the time being, his club said on Friday.
Bayern spokesman Markus Hoerwick said the 23-year-old had fallen at home and felt spasms of paralysis on the left side of his body.

"The problem was disturbances in his blood circulation," Hoerwick said, adding that the paralysis had subsided by midnight and no permanent damage had been done. "We can't yet say when he'll be released from hospital or when he'll play his next game."
Bayern wing-back Christian Ziege said: "When you see things like this, you realise how unimportant soccer really is."
